Then he wraps things up in his beachside kitchen with prawn and coconut fritters served with a pickled coconut slaw

England bounced back from a defeat at the hands of South Africa in the Southern Series with victories over Fiji and Argentina. Australia comfortably claimed their first win of the series against Italy after losses to Ireland and France. With analysis from Ugo Monye and George Gregan, pitchside reports by Topsy Ojo, and commentary from Nick Mullins, David Flatman and Ben Kay

events.name: James Martin's American Adventure
events.description: The chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles
